Cause (reproduced numerically): the absence look's evidence = -log density of the miss fraction under a beta fitted to the pooled in-place see-through share; the strict footprint look gives ~0.0003 on hole-free synthetic depth, present_beta clamps (mean 0.001, variance floor 1e-4) to a = 0.010 / b = 8.98 -> 9.6 nats at f = 0.51, cap 46.87 (decided a = 0.74 / b = 84 -> 89). Why it applies less on real data: real shares are 10-20x larger (A 0.0035, B 0.0047, C 0.0060 -> beta a 0.12-0.35, llr(0.51) 24-40, cap 170-300), and the real closures under the same rules were GT-right (real_row4i C, real_row4g B). Degree: real A has the smallest share (0.0035, llr(0.51) = 24, half the decided-era synthetic 56), so a partial-view object in real A could still close later than before; real A's own GT changes are few and the A gate counts closures. (2) B final-model depth L1 17.2 cm vs 11.0 and unobserved retention 72.8 % vs 75.4 % (absent_residue 20.2 vs 18.0) while own-time depth L1, geometry F1 and object F1 improved - cause not analysed; the real chain's retention_b/c and render metrics will measure it on real data. (3) D1 synthetic evaluator AssertionError in both versions (pre-existing).

(i) The training-dynamics effect of P1-off on real B/C (frozen sub-threshold rows no longer rendered for this session's earlier keyframes): only the export equivalence was measured; the chain measures the rest. (ii) The synthetic B final-model depth / retention regressions' cause. (iii) Real A under 04141fd itself (running; same core as 93.22/93.57). (iv) The present-beta clamp regime on real A (share 0.0035): closures will be compared with GT after A's evaluation (closure_compare + STATE_CHANGE_DETAILS).

Guard stop / driver error: keep the checkpoint, record the peak, no rerun. A gate STOP or B accept FAIL: offline analysis on the checkpoint (closure_compare, state_rows, g1_decompose), report, no GPU trial. Nothing in the decision core is changed in this chain; the present-beta clamp question stays with the user.
